title: Default EPS bearer context activation not accepted by the UE

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE attachment to the network, which may include default EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: ESM message sent by UE to reject default EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for ESM procedure failure.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE
entities.description: ESM state indicating that the bearer context is inactive.

entities.name: T3485
entities.description: Timer associated with default EPS bearer context activation procedure.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context activation is part of attach procedure
entities.description: Condition where default EPS bearer context activation occurs during attach procedure.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context activation is not part of attach procedure
entities.description: Condition where default EPS bearer context activation occurs standalone.

entities.name: ESM sublayer notifies EMM sublayer of ESM failure
entities.description: Behavior where ESM sublayer informs EMM sublayer about ESM procedure failure.

entities.name: MME enters BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE and stops T3485
entities.description: MME behavior upon receiving ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message.

relations.description: When default EPS bearer context activation is part of attach procedure, ESM sublayer notifies EMM of failure.
When default EPS bearer context activation is not part of attach procedure, UE sends reject message.
When default EPS bearer context activation is not part of attach procedure, UE enters BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE state.
ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message contains ESM cause IE.
Upon receiving ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT, MME enters BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE and stops T3485.
MME enters BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE state upon reject message.
MME stops timer T3485 upon receiving ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message.
